0.name: OPEN_PLAY
0.meaning: no restart pending; ball in play
0.evidence: cleared by restart_play 0x6c54a0 dispatch (dribble 6f.. cases 2..8 write 0), shootout step 0x6be710 state 2/5 writes 0, loose ball 0x6bbe40 rolls only when 0, engine_loop 0x6b98c0 runs restart only when != 0

2.name: THROW_IN
2.evidence: ball_out_of_play 0x6cd5d2 writes 2 with event 0x1f76 (= events_eng.cfg 54 EVENT_RESTART_THROW_IN); taker pass 0x36 from x 0/8 touchline (match_pl dribble)

3.name: CORNER
3.evidence: ball_out_of_play 0x6cd52c/0x6cd566 write 3 with event 0x1f75 (= 53 EVENT_RESTART_CORNER); corner_from_shot and keeper save over the line set 3 + 0x1f75; taker pass 0x34 into the box

4.name: GOAL_KICK
4.evidence: ball_out_of_play 0x6cd4fd/0x6cd595 write 4 with event 0x1f77 (= 55 EVENT_RESTART_GOAL_KICK); taker kick 0x5a to midfield rows

5.name: PENALTY
5.evidence: apply_foul 0x6bac40, contest 0x6c9cd0 and shot foul 0x702050 set 5 for a foul in the box with event 0x1f7a (= 58 EVENT_RESTART_PENALTY); taker shoots type 0x33; period_completed 0x6bd930 does not close the period while 5

6.name: FREE_KICK
6.evidence: same setters as 5 outside the box with event 0x1f79 (= 57 EVENT_RESTART_FREEKICK); taker may shoot directly (type 0x35, set piece 6) only when 6

7.name: INDIRECT_FREE_KICK
7.meaning: indirect free kick (offside, or a type-7 offence)
7.evidence: apply_foul 0x6bac40 sets 7 for pending kind 8 (offside, event 0x20ee = 430 EVENT_RESTART_OFFSIDE_PAST_TENSE) and kind 7; shot offside path writes 7; taker handles 6|7 together but never shoots directly when 7

8.name: KICK_OFF
8.meaning: kick-off (start of each period, after a goal)
8.evidence: period_completed 0x6bd930 sets 8 at each period change; engine_loop 0x6b98c0 narrates 0x212f/0x1f74 (= 495 EVENT_START_MATCH / 52 EVENT_KICK_OFF) when 8 and not yet announced; restart_play 0x6c54a0 resets stances when 8

ball_height.note: a height level 0..4 that drops by one per rolling step (roll_loose_ball 0x6bbe40), not a pure code; -1 and 5 are the special markers. Values 255 in the input are -1 read as u8.

-1.name: HELD_BY_GOALKEEPER
-1.meaning: the goalkeeper has the ball in his hands (255 when read as u8)
-1.evidence: take_ball 0x6f0630 writes 0xff at 0x6f0842 when the side's keeper takes the ball inside his own box; opposition_challenge refuses a challenge on the keeper while -1; shootout loop 0x6be710 stops when 0xff; attacking test match_pl:247

0.name: ON_GROUND
0.evidence: reset at restarts (0x6c54c9), shootout setup 0x6be883/0x6be9d0, loose ball stop 0x6bbe7e; floor of the per-step decrement

2.name: MID_HEIGHT
2.meaning: half-height driven ball (set by a long-range shot, move 0xc)
2.evidence: match_pl shot 0x6f701b writes 2 for the shot from distance; pass heights 1..3 drawn in play_pass_to

3.name: CHEST_HEIGHT
3.meaning: just below header height: a keeper catches it 3 times in 4 (move 1)
3.evidence: shared.rs:141 (decide_ball_action) picks the keeper catch move 1 for 3 with random(4) != 0

4.name: IN_THE_AIR
4.meaning: high ball (maximum level): headers for outfielders (move 0x15), catch for the keeper; crosses, corners and goal kicks start at 4
4.evidence: play_pass_to (match_pl ~6690) sets 4 for passes 0x1e/8/0x3c/0x34/0x5a; shared.rs choose move 0x15 heading when 4; opposition_challenge weight 3.5 when 4; injury 0xb on aerial clash 6918

5.name: LONG_SHOT_FREEZE
5.meaning: temporary marker while everyone re-decides during a long shot (saved and restored)
5.evidence: shot 0x702050 (match_eng.rs:4432) writes 5 around the re-decide loop; take_turn tests >= 5 at 0x6f3f9b

0.name: NONE
0.evidence: 0x6b7f54 init, 0x6bee86 end of shoot-out; referee 0x6e9630/0x6ea4e0 only punish when 0

1.name: YARD35_START
1.meaning: 35-yard shoot-out to be set up (side 1 starts); managers may pick takers
1.evidence: period_completed 0x6bdb1c/0x6bdf70 sets 1 for tie rule 0x20 (fixture TIE_RULES 0x20 = 35-yard shoot-out); engine_loop runs states 1..3 with mode 4 (taker run-up from row 7/4, keeper reacts up to 4 times); match_screens opens the tactics screen for 1|4

3.name: YARD35_RESULT
3.meaning: 35-yard shoot-out decided: narrate 0x2004 (196 EVENT_WIN_THE_SHOOTOUT), store the score
3.evidence: 0x6be710 state 2 -> 3 when mode 4; engine_loop rebuilds team stats only for 1..3

4.name: PENALTIES_START
4.meaning: penalty shoot-out to be set up (first side drawn at random); managers may pick takers
4.evidence: period_completed 0x6bdaf7/0x6bdf46 sets 4 for tie rule bit 1; engine_loop runs states 4..6 with mode 3 (direct shot); setup random(2) side

6.name: PENALTIES_RESULT
6.meaning: penalty shoot-out decided: narrate the winner, store the score

period_end.note: a tick count (minute x 11) except the two end markers 0 and 1

0.name: OVER_IN_NORMAL_TIME
0.meaning: match finished after 90 minutes (or going to a shoot-out from there)
0.evidence: period_completed 0x6bdb88/0x6bddd5 writes 0 at the end of the 2nd half; 0x6bd930 returns 4 (finished) for 0|1; engine_loop passes it to rebuild_team_match_stats

1.name: OVER_AFTER_EXTRA_TIME
1.meaning: match finished after extra time (incl. golden goal)
1.evidence: period_completed 0x6bdf99/0x6be02b writes 1 at the end of extra time and on golden goal; rebuild stats called with 1

495.name: FIRST_HALF_END
495.meaning: 0x1ef = minute 45 x 11: playing the first half
495.evidence: init 0x6b82a8 and 0x6beed1 write 0x1ef; period_completed narrates 0x20f1 (433 EVENT_HALF_TIME_WHISTLE) when the clock passes it

990.name: SECOND_HALF_END
990.meaning: 0x3de = minute 90 x 11: playing the second half
990.evidence: period_completed sets 0x3de after half time; 0x20f2 (434 EVENT_END_OF_NINETY_MINUTES) when passed; goal reaction match_pl:3364 tests 2nd half

1155.name: EXTRA_TIME_FIRST_HALF_END
1155.meaning: 0x483 = minute 105 x 11: first half of extra time

1320.name: EXTRA_TIME_END
1320.meaning: 0x528 = minute 120 x 11: second half of extra time
1320.evidence: 0x6be0dc writes 0x528; at the end goes to 1 or a shoot-out

pending_play_kind.note: the referee routines rewrite this byte in place with the punishment outcome (2 yellow, 3/4 red, 5/6 card variants) before apply_foul reads it back

0.name: NONE
0.evidence: clear_move/apply_foul 0x6bac40 clear to 0; move_counts 0x6bab90 and apply_foul return 0 when 0

1.name: FOUL
1.meaning: ordinary foul (direct free kick or penalty), not in the input but the base value the referee punishes
1.evidence: foul_decision 0x6e9820 returns 1; punish_foul 0x6e9630 / punish_move 0x6ea4e0 only card when kind == 1

7.name: INDIRECT_OFFENCE
7.meaning: offence punished by an indirect free kick (no card)
7.evidence: foul_decision 0x6e9820 returns 7 (move 0x2b); punish_move gives weight 1.25 and no card for 7; apply_foul sets restart 7 with 0x1f79

8.name: OFFSIDE
8.meaning: offside recorded by a shot/pass, applied later
8.evidence: shot 0x702050 offside path records kind 8 (record_move, match_eng.rs:4312); apply_foul 0x6bac40 narrates 0x20ee (430 EVENT_RESTART_OFFSIDE_PAST_TENSE), counts offsides, restart 7
